text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
SOYBEAN SALES - Two South Korean soy crushers bought a combined total of 50,000 tonnes Brazil soybeans from Marubeni Corp for July shipment, officials at the two firms said.
CORN AND SOYBEAN SALE - Taiwan's Hui Shung Group bought 38,000 tonnes of soybeans and 16,000 tonnes of corn from Cargill for late June delivery.
WHEAT SALES - Egypt bought 200,000 tonnes of soft red wheat from the United States for $148 to $148.50 a tonne for June delivery.
WHEAT SALES - Philippine firms bought 40,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat for June shipment, traders said.

- Sri Lanka's Cooperative Wholesale Establishment said it bought 100,000 tonnes of wheat. It bought 50,000 tonnes of Australian hard wheat at US$191.95 a tonne C&F for May 27 - June 5 shipment and 50,000 of Canadian western red spring wheat at $189.42 C&F for June 16-25.
WHEAT TENDER - Iraq seeks 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for July shipment under a United Nations oil-for-food deal. Tender offers were due on May 20.
SOYBEAN TENDERS - Shindongbang Corp, South Korea's largest edible oil producer, will buy 50,000 tonnes of Brazilian soybeans July and August shipment, a company official said.
- Kaohsiung division of Taiwan's Breakfast Soybean Procurement Association will tender Tuesday for 54,000 tonnes of Brazilian or Argentine soybeans for July, traders said.

TAPIOCA TENDER - South Korea's National Livestock Cooperatives Federation invited tenders to buy 45,000 tonnes of tapioca hard pellet Tuesday, a Federation official said. It also invited tenders to buy 20,000 tonnes of rice bran pellet and 18,000 tonnes of cottonseed meal the same day.
BARLEY TENDERS - Saudi Arabia seeks 700,000 tonnes of feed barley from the world market, European grain traders said.
- The Cyprus Grain Commission seeks 18,000 tonnes of maize, and 25,000 tonnes of barley May 20 for June shipment.
- Iran will tender Monday to import 100,000 tonnes of optional-origin feed barley for shipment in August.
LENTIL TENDER - Syria offered 16,000 tonnes of lentils for export. Bids are due May 20 and with confirmation May 21.
RICE TENDERS - Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foostuffs seeks offers June 4 to buy 12,000 tonnes of white rice for July, with confirmation on June 12.
RICE TENDERS - The state-run Rice Export Corporation of Pakistan invited bids by May 26 for the export of 5,000 tonnes of basmati Pak-7 rice containing seven percent broken.
- Jordan seeks 15,000 tonnes of medium grain camolina type rice on May 21 for June delivery
MARKET TALK - The Thailand livestock industry rushed to buy corn after the government on Friday approved the import of 200,000 tonnes of tariff-free corn, traders said.
... Japanese traders said they are rushing to cover their U.S. corn requirements for shipment in the third quarter of 1997 in anticipation of increases in U.S. corn premiums.
MARKET TALK - U.S. President Bill Clinton announced Monday the renewal of China's most favored nation trade privileges for another year.

...USDA's export inspections for the week ended May 15: soybeans 5.5 million bushels vs 12.618 million the previous week; wheat 9.282 million vs 12.836 million; corn 28.274 million vs 23.662 million; sorghum 2.654 million vs 3.422 million and barley 1.482 million vs 94,000.
